purpose: Verify exact live actuation, policy constraints, liveness, and overhead without examining terminal training quality.
pretraining_gates: Credential-free source, Megatron, protocol, and authorization payload hashes match.
The source archive is traversal-safe and contains the frozen runtime, config, analyzers, and tests.
The frozen offline result authenticates and reports PASS_M4_RESCUE_OFFLINE_QUALIFICATION.
Focused OARS-v2 controller tests, config tests, and M4-Rescue analyzer tests pass in the runtime image.
The resolved configuration exactly matches this protocol and the pinned TransferQueue commit.
terminal_gate: Learner versions 1 through 64 complete with exactly one decision per update.
Every decision has the exact eight-candidate controlled frontier and four selected groups.
Every configured proposal is exactly enacted, retains at least three FIFO groups, stays inside the two-sided token band, and does not reduce summed reward variance.
Every non-FIFO intervention strictly increases imminent registered L1 relative to FIFO.
All five scorer proposals use exact 70-combination search with zero skips or fallbacks.
Liveness accounting reconciles with lifecycle removals and combined observer/controller duty is at most one percent.
stop_rules: This protocol authorizes one submission attempt only.
No automatic retry, replacement, extension, or quality acquisition.
A failure is terminal for this qualification unless the user separately authorizes a scientifically justified repair.
